reviews.title: In “nowhere land”should be the name of this app.
reviews.text: Too confusing. It won’t adjust itself to where you are currently. When inputting address, it puts you is the pasture of a property that is not where the address is. Cannot get the location to change to any other location

reviews.title: Restore doesn’t work
reviews.text: Coming from android, it’s cool to see this on iOS but I can’t restore my purchase. Kinda disappointed when I press restore nothing happens. Been like that for a while

reviews.title: Kompass?
reviews.text: Leider funktioniert der Kompass nicht mehr in der App. Schade.

reviews.title: App constantly freezing up
reviews.text: Many, many times have I been outside at night trying to show someone the constellations or just use the app and it stayed frozen. After giving the app more than enough try’s I finally deleted it. Great concept, poor performance.

reviews.title: Horoscope shower
reviews.text: I downloaded app thinking it was similar to a digital telescope but it was hovering over planets with lynx libra and persus malarkey no thanks

reviews.title: Purchase
reviews.text: Sounds like they’re too greedy. You don’t get the best view. You would have to buy it. It’d be nice if they just sold more stars, but it’s not really nice that everything slightly blurry.

reviews.title: Tolle App aber keine Unterstützung von Google auf iPhone
reviews.text: Die Korrespondenz klappt sofort, die Antwort ist allerdings nicht zufriedenstellend. Durch Wechsel der E-Mail Adresse kann ich nicht mehr auf die Kaufversion zurückgreifen und muss die App nochmals bezahlen, wenn ich die Vollversion haben will, schade

reviews.title: Very intrusive App
reviews.text: Omg not being able to navigate away from a screen even not being able to shut down your phone to avoid a request for access is appalling. I uninstalled your very intrusive app.

reviews.title: I feel Scammed
reviews.text: I bought two times the pro version of Stellarium and on the app still show the free version, I can’t access to pro features. I already tried to restore on the buy page and reboot the phone but nothing works, I write to support team and they don’t answer, I feel so Scammed

reviews.title: Stellarium
reviews.text: Off by 20 degrees in a 360. Why would you want to purchase something that isn’t even accurate?
